name: ModelVariant656_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant656_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (spinning sprites rise from one model joint while a textured cone and dome open at another, singly or one per spawn step); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-673/740 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant673_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, without the work-size printf and its string (gModelVariant656_D23C8, which only the non-French images define: the North American and Japanese ones), and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
